text:
One very important aspect about quick commerce that nobody is looking at is fire compliance of dark stores.

 If local municipal authorities make it compulsory for every dark store above 1500 feet or so to be fire compliant then half of the stores might have to close down and quick commerce might fall quickly. 

Most of the companies are dependant on dark stores relying on low rental because of being in slums, or dilapidated buildings or other illegal structures. 
I know of a dark store of zepto in Mumbai which is more than 3000 ft. carpet, under litigation property and a court case going on and no fire compliance.

God forbid but one huge fire in any of the dark stores with couple of deaths will create a havoc in the entire QC industry.

The habits are completely different!!

text: A price sensitive market like India. The price is gonna play a huge role in the quick commerce business. But you need to realise that from an investor point of view that when these quick commerce company goes public, they have certain obligations towards the investor and their focus will be on profitability. 2 ways to achieve that a) reduce the customer acquisition cost and overall marketing, operation cost with efficiency in focus b) increase the charges of the platform service .  which will effect on the customer as they might shift to offline. I have an example related to food delivery business when a sabji is only 220 rupees on restaurant menu but with delivery charges , packages and other add on charges you get that same sabji for 320/340 paying an extra of 100/120 rupees. Which the Indian customer soon might not accept. The quick commerce business is a very sensitive business where a sudden change in trend, can make a huge difference on the sustainability of these company.
